subject: Coordinating demo for Lumenix - AE/SE/IT availability
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@lumenix.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Quick intro + demo for Lumenix?

Hi Sara —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood via the self-serve flow — saw your team created a trial yesterday. I wanted to introduce myself (Aditya, SDR) and loop in Olga (AE) and Karthik (SE) so we can schedule a short walkthrough tailored to your infra and security needs.

High-level plan: 30–40m call with AE + SE, plus one of your IT/security folks to confirm connectivity and any compliance questions. We can record if useful.

A few slots that work on our side (all PST):
- Tue 12 Jan — 10:00–10:40 AM PST
- Tue 12 Jan — 2:00–2:40 PM PST
- Wed 13 Jan — 11:00–11:40 AM PST

I attached our demo security checklist (redwood-demo-security-checklist.pdf) — helps IT know what we’ll ask to test (IP allowlist, VPN test, sample logs). If none of the times fit, tell me a couple of windows that do and we’ll adapt.

Would appreciate a quick confirmation of who from Lumenix should join (AE focus, SE deep-dive, IT/security).

Thanks!

—Aditya Rao
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
att: redwood-demo-security-checklist.pdf
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@lumenix.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lumenix IT <it-security@lumenix.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick intro + demo for Lumenix?

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the note and for the checklist. We did the quick trial spin-up; team is excited. A couple of constraints from our side: our IT/security team prefers meetings after 2:00 PM PST on weekdays to accommodate their maintenance window. Also, please include an SE — we’ll want to discuss proxy/VPN behavior and token redaction flow.

Proposed: Tue 12 Jan, 2:00–2:40 PM PST if that still works for your side. If not, Wed afternoon is possible. Please confirm the meeting link and who will be on the call from Redwood.

Best,
Sara Nguyen
Product Ops Lead, Lumenix
cc: it-security@lumenix.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 08:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick intro + demo for Lumenix?

Grace / Karthik —

FYI: Sara from Lumenix confirmed they need IT present and prefer after 2pm PST on Tue 12 Jan. Please see the customer note below.

Grace: can you own the AE portion (intro, success metrics, 10–12m)? Karthik: please prep to show proxy/VPN handling, token redaction, and a short troubleshooting checklist (10–15m). We should leave 5–10m for IT questions.

Plan B: if IT cannot be on the live call we’ll record the SE section and schedule a 15m follow-up technical sync with their IT team.

Aditya — please hold the 2:00 PM PST slot and send an updated invite with the security checklist attached and the ICS. I’ll join from 2:00–2:40.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@lumenix.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Updated invite + timezone conversions

Hi Sara —

Thanks for confirming. I’ve tentatively booked Tue, 12 Jan 2027, 2:00–2:40 PM PST and attached the calendar ICS (proposed-times.ics). Invite link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234 (please let me know if you prefer Zoom).

Quick timezone conversions for the group: 2:00 PM PST = 5:00 PM EST / 10:00 PM GMT.

Attendees from Redwood: Olga Petrov (AE), Grace O'Connor (Senior AE), Karthik Iyer (SE).

Attached again: redwood-demo-security-checklist.pdf — IT, if you can scan the checklist ahead of time we’ll only ask to validate the bold items during the call (allowlist IPs, test token exchange, brief VPN handshake). If you have a preferred test machine for the VPN check, please share that host IP.

If IT needs a later slot on Wed 13 Jan afternoon, we can move — just let me know.

Thanks!
—Aditya
att: proposed-times.ics, redwood-demo-security-checklist.pdf
From: Lumenix IT <it-security@lumenix.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Updated invite + timezone conversions

Hi team —

We can confirm Tue 12 Jan at 2:00 PM PST works for our security engineer (Maya Patel will join). She’ll be on the call for the VPN/proxy and token questions. Our test host for the VPN handshake is 10.23.45.12 (internal) — we’ll provide a temporary externally routable endpoint before the meeting.

Please share the meeting URL and any test prep step we should run <24h before. Also confirm recording is ok — we’ll need it for our compliance notes.

Thanks,
Lumenix IT
it-security@lumenix.com
